description: Risk features computed by the backend from TaskEvent history as known at prediction time. Must match backend/src/risk-features/feature-spec.ts.

features.name: hours_to_deadline
features.description: Hours from prediction time to the effective deadline (date-only due dates end at midnight in the workspace time zone).

features.name: deadline_is_date_only
features.description: 1 when the due date is a calendar date, 0 for an explicit time.

features.name: task_age_hours
features.description: Hours since the task was created.

features.name: deadline_lead_hours
features.description: Hours between when the current due date was set and the deadline.

features.name: status_todo
features.description: 1 when the status is TODO.

features.name: status_in_progress
features.description: 1 when the status is IN_PROGRESS.

features.name: status_in_review
features.description: 1 when the status is IN_REVIEW.

features.name: hours_in_status
features.description: Hours since the last status change (or creation).

features.name: status_change_count
features.description: Number of status changes.

features.name: reopen_count
features.description: Number of transitions out of DONE.

features.name: due_date_change_count
features.description: Number of due-date changes after creation.

features.name: postpone_count
features.description: Number of due-date changes that moved the deadline later.

features.name: has_assignee
features.description: 1 when the task is assigned.

features.name: assignee_change_count
features.description: Number of assignee changes after creation.

features.name: assignee_open_tasks
features.description: Other open tasks assigned to the same person at prediction time.

features.name: assignee_overdue_tasks
features.description: Other open tasks of the same person whose deadline had passed at prediction time.

features.name: comment_count
features.description: Comments on the task at prediction time.

features.name: comments_last_7d
features.description: Comments added in the 7 days before prediction time.

features.name: events_last_7d
features.description: Task events in the 7 days before prediction time.

features.name: hours_since_last_event
features.description: Hours since the most recent task event.

features.name: priority
features.description: Task priority (0-3).
